skins.name: Forever Together
skins.description: Black tea, lemon, colorful little sweets, and lots of soft, friendly companions. Forget stiff manners and anything that ties you down, and just lie back. Your friends' warm, welcoming arms are always there to embrace you.

skins.name: Relaxing Trip
skins.description: Mark monsters, fortresses, and treasures on the map. Bring along your beloved dolls, a warm drink, and a cheerful mood. Come on, this is what it means to start a trip.
